verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no built-in Basecamp AI that answers questions with citations from workspace content. The closest items are 'Official Basecamp support for ChatGPT, Claude, and AI agents with full MCP support' and 'CLI access and skills for AI agents.' These let external AI tools reach Basecamp data, but that is an adjacent integration building block rather than the product's own Q&A capability. Nothing documents instant answers or citations back to workspace items.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can ask AI a question and get an instant answer with citations from my workspace content
